payload.body: The shoe-opening burn ritual is anchored, not centred: .burn-stage is a zero-size anchor at left 25% / top 50% of the felt, with children hung off it by half their own token-derived size. The 1.25 oversize lives on .burn-card-slot, NOT on the burn-expose keyframe, so entry motion and persistent size stop fighting. Burned cards form a left-anchored grid beside the card — max five columns, rows = ceil(n/5), a short final row centred on a half column — with the grid midline pinned to the card midline. Motion is burn-place in (CSS-staggered via --anim-burn-stagger) and burn-gather out, collapsing every card onto cell 0 in reverse order, over a radial scrim. burnGridLayout / burnWaitSchedule / burnRitualBudget are pure and unit-tested for counts 1-10, including a 3000ms felt-lock budget read out of anim.css, so a duration bump that overruns the lock fails the suite.
